text:
A snapped main stem counts as damaged on arrival, and you have **48 hours from delivery** to report it. Include photos of the plant and the box. If it's covered, you can choose a free replacement sent on the next plant shipping day (live plants ship Monday-Wednesday) or a refund.

If the 48 hours have passed, the claim goes through the Plant Care Guarantee instead. That's a 30-day window from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members), and it needs at least two photos (whole plant and close-up) submitted from "My Orders."
